name: ronin
description: RONIN — A Vagabond-inspired first-person 3D multiplayer samurai combat game

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.start: npm run build && cd server && NODE_ENV=production PORT=${PORT:-8080} node dist/server/src/index.js
scripts.serve: cd server && NODE_ENV=production PORT=${PORT:-8080} node dist/server/src/index.js
